def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
                      (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
                      (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a NumPy array')
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a 2D array, got shape {arr.shape}')
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must not be empty')
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f'{name} contains non-finite values')
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f'{name} contains positive values')

    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError('All input arrays must have the same shape')

    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError('tau_filter must not be a boolean value')
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError(f'tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative, got {tau_filter}')

    # Normalized future-token weights (T01)
    horizon = shape[1]
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Weighted future-token loss per candidate (T02): loss = -sum(weight * logp)
    def weighted_loss(logp: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return -np.dot(logp, weights)  # shape (n_candidates,)

    L_plus = weighted_loss(logp_with_result)
    L_call_only = weighted_loss(logp_call_only)
    L_empty = weighted_loss(logp_no_call)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline (T03)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)

    # Margin and threshold filter (T04)
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
